description: Online Learning Dashboard — monitors the continual learning system that operates after every workflow run. Displays bandit-based model routing Q-tables, performance drift detection signals, ADCA step credit attribution scorecards, evolvable strategy bank contents, and post-run experience summaries. Data is fetched from 8 MCP API endpoints under /online-learning/* and auto-refreshes on drift-detected Tauri events + 60s polling.

groups.name: Page Structure & Layout
groups.description: The page has a fixed header with title and refresh button, a sub-tab bar with 6 tabs, and a scrollable content area. The background is dark (#0a0a0f). The layout is a vertical flex column filling the available height.

assertions.description: The page header displays 'Online Learning' as the title text.
A 'Refresh' button is present in the header bar for manual data reload.

Clicking the Refresh button triggers a fresh fetch of all 7 online learning API endpoints (/online-learning/model-routing, /model-routing/table, /drift-signals, /drift-monitor, /step-scorecard, /strategies, /experiences) and updates the displayed data without a full page reload.
While data is being fetched, a 'Loading...' text with pulse animation appears next to the page title.
assertions.precondition: Data is being fetched (initial load or refresh in progress)

groups.name: Sub-Tab Navigation
groups.description: Six sub-tabs allow switching between dashboard views: Overview, Model Routing, Drift Detection, Step Credits, Strategies, and Experiences. The active tab is highlighted with blue styling. The Drift Detection tab shows a badge count when drift signals are present.

assertions.description: Exactly 6 sub-tab buttons are present: Overview, Model Routing, Drift Detection, Step Credits, Strategies, Experiences.
The 'Model Routing' sub-tab is present.
The currently active tab has a blue background (bg-blue-500/20) and blue text (text-blue-400), while inactive tabs have muted text (text-white/50). On initial load, the Overview tab is active.

Clicking a tab switches the content area to display the corresponding panel without losing data or triggering a refetch. Switching from Overview to Model Routing shows the Q-table; switching to Drift Detection shows drift signals.

When unacknowledged drift signals exist, the Drift Detection tab shows an amber badge with the signal count (e.g., '3'). The badge has amber background (bg-amber-500/20) and amber text. When there are no drift signals, no badge is shown.

groups.name: Overview — Stat Cards
groups.description: The Overview tab displays 4 stat cards in a 4-column grid showing: Routing Entries count, Drift Signals count, Step Types Scored count, and Strategies count. Each card has a large number, a label, and a sub-label with additional context.

assertions.description: A stat card labeled 'Routing Entries' displays the number of (context, model) pairs in the Q-table, with a sub-label showing the number of available models (e.g., '3 models').

A stat card labeled 'Drift Signals' displays the count of unacknowledged drift signals. When signals are present, the card has an amber border and background tint (border-amber-500/30, bg-amber-500/5) to draw attention. The sub-label shows the total detector count.
A stat card labeled 'Step Types Scored' displays the count of distinct step types that have credit attribution data, with sub-label 'credit attribution'.
A stat card labeled 'Strategies' displays the total strategy count with a sub-label showing how many are active (e.g., '2 active').

groups.name: Overview — Drift Alert Banner
groups.description: When drift signals exist, an amber-bordered alert banner appears below the stat cards showing up to 5 recent drift signals with their metric name, context key, and mean shift values.

assertions.description: When unacknowledged drift signals exist, an 'Active Drift Signals' section with amber border appears. Each signal line shows a colored dot (red for drift, amber for warning), the metric name, context key, and pre/post mean values separated by an arrow.
assertions.precondition: At least one unacknowledged drift signal exists in the database

assertions.description: When there are no unacknowledged drift signals, the 'Active Drift Signals' banner is not rendered.
assertions.precondition: No drift signals exist in the database

assertions.description: Each drift signal displayed must show: (1) a drift_level indicator dot — red for 'drift', amber for 'warning'; (2) the metric_name (composite_score, success_rate, cost_usd, or duration_secs); (3) the context_key in domain:complexity:has_ui format; (4) pre_drift_mean and post_drift_mean numeric values. If the post_drift_mean is lower than pre_drift_mean for composite_score, this indicates performance degradation.
assertions.precondition: Drift signals are visible

groups.name: Model Routing — Q-Table Display
groups.description: The Model Routing tab shows the full bandit Q-table: every (context, model) pair with its learned Q-value and visit count. Available models are listed as badges above the table. The table is sorted by Q-value descending. Model names are truncated for readability.

assertions.description: Available model names are displayed as small badges above the Q-table. Default models are claude-haiku-4-5, claude-sonnet-4, and claude-opus-4.
assertions.precondition: Model routing data has been loaded

assertions.description: The Q-table has 4 columns: Context (context_key in prompt:file:complexity:domain:ui format), Model (truncated name), Q-Value (4 decimal places), and Visits (integer count).
assertions.precondition: Model routing tab is active and data exists

assertions.description: When no model routing data exists, the message 'No model routing data yet. The bandit learns from workflow outcomes.' is displayed instead of the table.
assertions.precondition: Model routing tab is active and no data has been collected

assertions.description: All Q-values in the table must be between 0.0 and 1.0 inclusive. A Q-value outside this range indicates a bug in the bandit reward computation (reward = composite_score - 0.01 * cost, clamped to [0,1]).
assertions.precondition: Q-table has at least one row

groups.name: Drift Detection — Signals Table
groups.description: The Drift Detection tab shows a status line with detector count and algorithm names, plus a table of all unacknowledged drift signals with severity, metric, context, detector type, and pre/post drift means.

assertions.description: A status line shows the number of active detectors and the algorithm names: 'ADWIN + DDM + Page-Hinkley'. ADWIN handles continuous metrics (score, cost, duration), DDM handles binary outcomes (success rate), and Page-Hinkley detects gradual trends.
assertions.precondition: Drift Detection tab is active and drift monitor is initialized

assertions.description: The drift signals table has 6 columns: Level (badge with 'drift' or 'warning'), Metric, Context, Detector, Pre-Drift (4 decimal places), Post-Drift (4 decimal places). Drift-level badges are red; warning-level badges are amber.
assertions.precondition: Drift Detection tab is active and drift signals exist

assertions.description: When no drift signals exist, the message 'No drift signals. The system is monitoring composite score, success rate, cost, and duration per context.' is shown.
assertions.precondition: Drift Detection tab is active and no signals exist

groups.name: Step Credits — Attribution Scorecard
groups.description: The Step Credits tab shows aggregated credit attribution across all runs, grouped by step type. Each row shows the step type, average normalized credit, average raw credit, observation count, and a horizontal bar visualizing the credit magnitude.

assertions.description: The credits table has 5 columns: Step Type, Avg Credit (4 decimal places, blue monospace), Raw Credit (4 decimal places), Count, and a visual Bar. The table is sorted by average credit descending (highest-contributing step types first).
assertions.precondition: Step Credits tab is active and credit data exists

assertions.description: Each row has a green (emerald-500/60) horizontal bar whose width is proportional to the normalized credit value. The bar fills a fixed-width container. A step type with higher credit has a wider bar than one with lower credit.
assertions.precondition: Credits table has at least two rows

assertions.description: When no credit data exists, the message 'No step credits yet. Credits are computed from pipeline traces after each workflow run.' is shown.
assertions.precondition: Step Credits tab is active and no data exists

groups.name: Strategies — Evolvable Strategy Bank
groups.description: The Strategies tab shows cards for each active or candidate strategy. Each card displays the strategy name, status badge, description, and performance stats. Strategies are created by extracting configurations from P90+ performing runs.

assertions.description: Each strategy card shows: (1) name as a white heading, (2) status badge — green for 'active', blue for 'candidate', grey for 'degraded'/'retired', (3) description text in muted white, (4) performance stats: Selected count, Success percentage, Avg Score (3 decimal places), Avg Cost (2 decimal places with $ prefix).
assertions.precondition: Strategies tab is active and at least one strategy exists

assertions.description: Strategy status badges use consistent colors: 'active' = emerald green (bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400), 'candidate' = blue (bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400), 'degraded' or 'retired' = grey (bg-white/10 text-white/40). These match the severity semantics — active strategies are proven, candidates are under evaluation.
assertions.precondition: At least one strategy exists

assertions.description: When no strategies exist, the message 'No strategies yet. Strategies are extracted from P90+ performing runs and validated through canary testing.' is shown.
assertions.precondition: Strategies tab is active and no strategies exist

groups.name: Experiences — Run Summaries
groups.description: The Experiences tab shows cards for recent experience summaries extracted after each workflow run. Each card shows the outcome badge, domain, complexity tier, truncated task run ID, and counts of key decisions, failure points, and effective patterns.

assertions.description: Each experience card shows: (1) outcome badge — green for success/complete/completed, red for failure/failed, (2) domain tag, (3) complexity tier, (4) truncated task_run_id (first 12 chars + '...') aligned right, (5) counts: 'N decisions', 'N failures', 'N patterns'.
assertions.precondition: Experiences tab is active and at least one experience exists

assertions.description: When no experiences exist, the message 'No experience summaries yet. Experiences are extracted after each workflow run.' is shown.
assertions.precondition: Experiences tab is active and no experiences exist

groups.name: Visual Design & Dark Theme
groups.description: The dashboard uses a dark theme consistent with the runner's design system. All text must be legible against dark backgrounds. Cards use subtle borders and transparency.

assertions.description: The page background is #0a0a0f (near-black). All content panels use white/[0.02] or white/[0.03] backgrounds for subtle contrast against the page background. Borders use white/10 opacity.

Primary text (titles, stat numbers) uses white/90 opacity. Secondary text (labels, descriptions) uses white/60. Tertiary text (sub-labels, IDs) uses white/30-40. All text is legible against the dark background — no text should be invisible or nearly invisible.
Stat card numbers use text-2xl font-semibold in white/90. Labels use text-xs in white/60. Sub-labels use text-[10px] in white/30.
assertions.precondition: Overview tab is active

assertions.description: Table rows have a hover effect (bg-white/[0.02]) providing visual feedback. Rows are separated by subtle borders (border-white/5).
assertions.precondition: A tab with a data table is active and the table has rows

groups.name: Data Freshness & Real-Time Updates
groups.description: The dashboard subscribes to the 'drift-detected' Tauri event for real-time drift notification and polls all endpoints every 60 seconds. This ensures the dashboard reflects the current state of the online learning system without manual refresh.

assertions.description: The dashboard automatically refreshes all data every 60 seconds without user interaction. After 60 seconds, any new drift signals, routing updates, or experience summaries appear in the UI.

When the Rust backend emits a 'drift-detected' Tauri event (triggered by the drift detection engine detecting a performance shift), the dashboard immediately refreshes all data to show the new drift signal. The drift count badge on the Drift Detection tab updates in real-time.

groups.name: Algorithm Output Correctness
groups.description: The dashboard displays outputs from several online learning algorithms. These assertions verify that the displayed data is internally consistent and reflects correct algorithm behavior.

assertions.description: In the Model Routing Q-table, the visit count for each (context, model) pair must be a non-negative integer. The total visits across all models for a given context should be >= 3 (the minimum activation threshold). If any context shows total visits < 3 but has a non-fallback routing decision, the bandit activated too early.
assertions.precondition: Model Routing tab is active and Q-table has data

assertions.description: For a given task run's step credits (visible via the Step Credits tab), the sum of all normalized_credit values should approximately equal the workflow's composite_agentic_score. A significant discrepancy indicates a normalization bug in the ADCA credit assignment algorithm.
assertions.precondition: Step Credits tab shows per-run credit data

assertions.description: Every strategy must have a provenance description explaining how it was created: 'Extracted from run X' (P90+ run extraction), 'Failure-mined from X' (failure contrast analysis), or 'Variant of X' (mutation). A strategy without clear provenance indicates a creation bug.
assertions.precondition: Strategies tab has at least one strategy
